lines: Not should he perform any saṃskāra for him: thus says the god in the G
ahvara — what of his full one, by śrāddha-and-the-rest considered?
l4.sanskrit_cite: na tasya kuryātsaṃskāraṃ kaṃcidityāha gahvare devaḥ kimasya pūrṇasya śrāddhādyairiti bhāvitaḥ
